paper_id: SC-Tune_ Unleashing Self-Consistent Referential Comprehension in Large Vision Language Models
title: SC-Tune: Unleashing Self-Consistent Referential Comprehension in Large Vision Language Models
motivation: 现有LVLM在bbox-caption-bbox循环一致性上存在显著缺陷,域外泛化能力急剧下降
problem_framing: 将视觉语言模型的自洽能力定义为REG和REC任务的循环一致性,并提出交替优化框架
key_insight: 借鉴DQN目标网络思想,describer和locator互为目标网络,通过交替训练实现协同提升
method_signature: SC-Tune cyclical fine-tuning with PPO for describer and MLE for locator
evaluation_criteria: IoU>0.5的bbox预测准确率,零样本域外泛化性能
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: 引入SC-Tune后在RefCOCO上有轻微性能下降,但这是泛化能力的可接受代价
evidence_for_taste: not to achieve further improvement on a specific benchmark
this fluctuation is acceptable as a trade-off
even specialized model for captioning does not perform as well
thinking_moves: 从初步实验发现现有方法忽视的自洽能力缺口
将REG和REC的非对称训练重新框架为循环一致性优化
借鉴DQN目标网络解决梯度回传中的循环依赖
接受域内性能下降以换取泛化能力的策略性权衡
通过可视化案例揭示captioning与grounding能力的不匹配
